item.tib: mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi dbang bzhi bskur ba'i rim pa las nang dbang nyi ma'i zer 'phreng
item.coloph: ces mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi nang dbang nyi ma'i zer phreng 'di ni/ shar phyogs bkod pa'i zhing khams kyi byang gi char/ khro chen rgyal po'i mnga' ris kyi tha gru mu la spo yo lung gi ngo mtshar nor bu'i gling du/ snyig (snyigs) dus kyi rnal 'byor 'ja' tshon snying pos me 'brug zla tshes la brtsams pa 'dis kyang / bstan 'gro phan bde chen po'i rgyu ru gyur cig
